description: A record of the indexes made by hand in the Firebase console (Firestore Database -> Indexes). It is written to look like the console, not in the Firebase CLI format, so it can't be deployed; it only shows the team what must exist. JSON has no comments, so each entry has a description text instead.

compositeIndexes.description: A user's posts, newest first: the post list on My profile and on public profiles (All chip). Made in the Composite tab.
A user's posts of one post type, newest first: the post type chips (Love, Gratitude, ...) on My profile and on public profiles. Made in the Composite tab.

exemptions.description: Finds all of a user's comments on every post at once (collection group query): changing the username (the copies in comments are updated) and deleting the account. Made in the Single field tab -> Add exemption.

Finds all of a user's reactions on every post at once (collection group query): deleting the account (each reaction is removed and the post's count goes down). Made in the Single field tab -> Add exemption.
